title: Prior Relocks and Long Extensions in Rate Lock Commitment Relock Fees
content:
**Pricing note: the extension step on a Rate Lock Commitment relock fee.** A step is added to the relock fee points according to how much the lock has already been carried. The basis is the lock's pricing ledger: any relock fee entry from an earlier relock, and the extension days of its extension entries.

**Rule.**

- When the lock carries a relock fee entry from an earlier relock, the prior-relock step of **0.125** points is added.
- When it carries none, and its extension entries add up to at least the long-extension days of **30**, the long-extension step of **0.1** points is added.
- Otherwise none is added.

| Relock fee entry from an earlier relock | Extension days booked in total | Step (points) |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Any | 0.125 |
| No | 30 or more | 0.1 |
| No | 29 or fewer | 0 |

*Boundary cases (hypothetical):* a first relock on a lock whose extensions add up to 30 days takes 0.1 points. With 29 days it takes none. A lock relocked once before takes 0.125 points, whatever its extensions.
